about_the_game:
Jump, Climb, Reach the Top!

As a frog, your destiny is calling you—upwards! Frog Jump is a challenging yet fun platforming adventure that puts your skills to the test. Your goal? Conquer treacherous obstacles and master precise jumps to reach the top of a massive castle, where a kiss from the princess awaits. But be careful—one wrong move, and you might fall all the way down!

Play Solo or with up to 8 Friends!

Take on the challenge alone or compete with up to 8 players in this chaotic multiplayer platformer. Race your friends to the top, sabotage their progress, or just sit back and watch them tumble down! Who will be the first to claim the royal kiss?

Sabotage Your Friend's Way to the Top!

It's not just about reaching the top—it's about stopping your rivals from getting there first! Use your frog's unique abilities, like sticking your tongue out or delivering a mid-air kick, to sabotage other players and prevent them from reaching the princess. With these skills, you can throw off their timing, send them plummeting down, and race ahead to claim the royal kiss for yourself!

At Massive World, Brutal Parkour!

  • Increasing Difficulty: The higher you go, the harder it gets! Navigate tricky obstacles, balance on slippery surfaces, and time your jumps perfectly to keep climbing.

  • Master Unique Controls: Every jump matters! Plan your movements carefully—one misstep could send you straight back to the bottom.

  • Fall, but Never Give Up! Failure is just part of the journey! True mastery comes from learning, adapting, and jumping again.

Are you ready for the ultimate test? Climb the castle, reach the top, and claim your well-earned kiss!

name: Frog Jump

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor (4 core, 2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 6-core or better Intel or AMD processor (3.0 GHz+)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High-definition (HD) audio compatible sound card with support for 5.1 or 7.1 surround sound (for more immersive sound experiences in UE5)

short_description: Ready to jump? In Frog Jump, you're a simple frog on a quest to reach the castle’s peak and earn the princess’s kiss! Master tricky jumps, overcome tough parkour challenges, and play with up to 8 friends. Be the first frog to claim the royal kiss!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Portuguese - Portugal
